_about: Commands for the ABApp shortcut. Each command has a label (its button on the Home tab) and steps run in order. Step types: notify {title, body}; request {url, secret?} does a GET of url, replacing {secret} with the named key from the shortcut's Secrets dictionary. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
